title: Mercy for the undeserving hour
subtitle: A short return when kindness feels too generous to receive
description: A brief path for receiving mercy before the heart tries to earn, explain, or control its way back.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Mercy gives Naam and gathers what has wandered; return begins before you can manufacture it.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Receive the mercy that reaches first, then answer it with one honest turn back.

evidence.coreClaim: This bundle teaches the heart to receive mercy before trying to deserve it.
evidence.turn: Mercy is already close enough to begin the return.
evidence.practicalImplication: Stop bargaining with unworthiness and make one clean movement back toward Naam.
